title: Craftfolio: Patterns & Projects
short_description: Save PDF craft patterns, organise knitting and crochet projects, and keep row counters and notes together offline.
long_description:
Every pattern saved. Every project remembered.

Craftfolio brings your PDF and image patterns, craft projects and row counts into one calm workspace for compatible Fire tablets.

Your Personal Pattern Library
Import PDF, JPEG, PNG and WebP patterns. Search titles and filter by craft to find the knitting, crochet or sewing pattern you need. Original files are copied into local app storage, so reading does not depend on the source location remaining available. Export an original file whenever you need it.

Read And Count Together
Zoom and pan across your pattern, move between PDF pages and return to your project's saved reading position. On wide tablet layouts, view the pattern and counters side by side. Large plus and minus controls help you keep your place, and undo corrects an accidental count.

Remember Your Project
Create, edit, pause, resume and complete projects. Keep materials requirements and project notes beside the pattern. Your library, counters and notes work offline without registration or Google Play Services.

Free And Premium
Free includes up to 20 pattern imports, 3 unfinished projects and one counter per project. Premium adds unlimited pattern imports, unlimited projects and multiple named counters. Existing imported files, projects and counters remain accessible if Premium ends. Amazon manages subscription purchases and renewals. Verified Premium access requires reconnection at least every 72 hours; personal files stay available offline.

Private By Design
No advertising, social feeds or analytics. Patterns and project notes stay on your device. Purchase verification uses Amazon account and receipt identifiers only. Uninstalling the app removes local app data, so keep your source files or export originals first.

A thoughtful place to organise your next creative project.

Choose your language directly in the app. Imported patterns and personal project text are not translated automatically.
feature_bullets: Import and search PDF and image craft patterns
Track knitting, crochet and sewing projects offline
Read patterns beside large row counters with undo
Save project notes, materials requirements and reading position
Keep access to your imported files when Premium ends
premium_description: More room for your knitting and crochet projects: unlimited pattern imports and projects, plus multiple named row counters per project, within available device storage. Monthly and annual plans include the same Premium features. Imported files and existing project data stay accessible when the subscription ends. Patterns are not included. Payment and automatic renewal follow the selected Amazon subscription terms. Verified Premium requires reconnection at least every 72 hours.
